summary: The filing is an 8-K update on a previously disclosed private placement of convertible notes and warrants with White Lion Capital, noting a second closing on April 16, 2026. It reports an additional $500,000 in net proceeds from a $555,556 face-amount convertible note and 734,214 warrants. The filing discloses the creation of a direct financial obligation (Item 2.03) and is not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. It is a routine financing disclosure.
